pages.title: One route, both fluxes
pages.text: A Power Combiner takes separate Negarite and Posirite networks and feeds $(item)Combined Connectors$(). Use Combined Cable between those connectors and your machines.$(br2)Supply the combiner with both separate power types first. Touching different colored cables together does not combine their supplies.

pages.title: Set the transfer rate
pages.text: Use the combiner’s hologram slider and arrows to set its maximum input transfer per tick. The default limit is 1,000 of each, giving up to 980 of each at the output.$(br2)When either supply is below the limit, the combiner transfers the available matching pair. A high limit does not stop a smaller supply.$(br2)Combination loses $(thing)2%$(). In and Out show the configured limits; actual transfer depends on supply. Multiple output connectors share that output.
